A chi-square test of independence between the buyer's question and whether the seller disclosed gives χ² = 40.13 with 2 degrees of freedom and p ≈ 1.9e-9. That is far below 0.05, so we reject the null hypothesis that the question had no effect.

Disclosure counts by question (73 sellers in each group):

| Question | Disclosed | Hid |
|---|---|---|
| General | 2 | 71 |
| Negative assumption | 36 | 37 |
| Positive assumption | 23 | 50 |

ANSWER: reject
